mission_10: Implement the Information Bottleneck method, a powerful framework for finding optimal compressed representations that balance compression of input data with preservation of relevant information about a target variable. The IB method minimizes the objective IB = I(X;T) - beta * I(T;Y), where T is the compressed representation, X is the input, Y is the target, and beta controls the tradeoff. The self-consistent equations for IB are derived using variational methods and solved iteratively. The Information Bottleneck has deep connections to deep learning - it has been shown that neural network training implicitly implements the IB principle, with each layer creating progressively more compressed and task-relevant representations. This framework provides a theoretical foundation for understanding representation learning.
